text:
jia: Heads-up — ran the long-context canary for the new q4_0 family and we got a small but consistent quality regression on long prompts. ~2% top-1 label flips on the golden subset compared to q8 baseline. want to sync on curation changes before we push more canaries. :frowning:
omar: Ugh. Do you have the failure modes broken down? specific intents or truncation-related? :eyes:
jia: Mostly paraphrase/role-switch hallucinations when prompts exceed ~2k tokens. Example: system messages + multistep instructions get rephrased and change the expected entity. Small cluster of synthetic long instructions also showed higher entropy. I ran a quick diff against goldset_v12 and saw clusters where the model prefers a shorter inferred answer.
rachel: Could be a sampling/dup detection issue — long prompts currently get aggressive dedupe and sometimes we drop subtle context. Proposal: extend golden set with ~200 longtail prompts and relax fingerprint window for >1024 tokens. Also add labeling guideline for "preserve verbatim instruction" cases.
jia: Agreed on expanding golden. I can assemble 250 candidates from recent ingestion and the holdout window. Will flag ones that triggered flips.
elena: For labeling: add explicit rule: if the instruction contains multi-step numbered items, annotators must prefer verbatim step-preservation unless it contradicts safety. Short note to include in the UI: "Prefer preserving step order and wording when intent is sequencing."
tony: I can run a targeted eval and push a quick quant-config sweep (q4_0 variants + kv-cache tweak). I'll do runs with and without dedupe relax to measure delta. Command I'll use:```bash
./eval/run_canary.sh --model q4_0-long --prompts long_canary_prompts.json --gold goldset_v12.json --out results/q4long_canary.json --dedupe-window 1024
./eval/run_canary.sh --model q4_0-long --prompts long_canary_prompts.json --gold goldset_v12.json --out results/q4long_canary_nodedupe.json --dedupe-window 4096
```
ml-ops-bot: job qcanary-1746823456 started on pool-004 (eta ~18m) :rocket:
jia: Nice. Tony — when you have results, can you include per-cluster confusion and the prompt fingerprints? want to see whether collisions increase after quant changes.
tony: will do. also planning a tiny ablation: same model but with kv-cache disabled to spot cache-merge artifacts.
elena: Quick annotation blurbs for the labelers (copyable):```text
- If a prompt contains numbered steps, labelers should mark the expected answer to keep step order.
- If model truncates or omits steps, mark as "missing-step" and add freeform note.
- For paraphrase-sensitive tasks (legal clauses, config templates), prefer verbatim match; label as "verbatim-required".
```
jia: Perfect. I'll prepare the candidate set and upload to the curation queue with tags: longctx, canary-q4, preserve-steps.
omar: One more ask — add a small sentinel subset of short prompts so we can confirm no regressions on non-long tails. Keeps the baseline sanity check.
rachel: I'll update the dedupe service config to add a conditional rule: if token_count>2048, use relaxed fingerprint window and lower collision threshold. We'll run it in shadow for 24h first.
jia: Timeline: collect candidates today, labelers have 48h, Tony runs eval tomorrow morning, shadow dedupe flips for 24h, then we can decide whether this is a model/quant issue or a curation rule fix.
elena: I'll post the labeler guide to the curation board and ping the annotators group.
tony: starting the eval now (kicking off second job after dedupe-off config). will post results + confusion matrix here.

jia: Thanks — grabbing artifacts and will begin cluster-level triage. tagging @rachel @tony @elena for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
